title: The data center boom has an upside: innovation for the US grid
summary: As the AI boom stresses the existing power grid, all sorts of new opportunities for grid modernization are also emerging as a result, industry insiders say.
llm_summary: The surge in data‑center construction driven by AI is putting extra strain on America’s aging power grid, but it’s also sparking a wave of innovation. Utilities and tech firms are using the demand spike as a catalyst to roll out smarter, more resilient infrastructure—like advanced monitoring, flexible load‑management tools, and renewable‑integration technologies—that could modernize the grid for the long term.
